signatures.summary: High CPU coincides with elevated service latency; workload and runtime causes need investigation.
High container memory utilization coincides with elevated latency; a leak is not proven by this snapshot.
This service's own spans are the deepest failing ones in sampled error traces while its error ratio is above baseline; its callers' errors are knock-on effects.
The container's CPU limit is below its baseline while its latency is above baseline: CPU starvation.
The container's memory limit was updated below its compose value: memory starvation; expect OOM restarts.
